raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-16 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. The pipeline treats both as local, so v2 rows are 6 hours ahead (CST in January). Evening v2 transactions land in the 00:00-06:00 window and roll into the next txn_date, which explains the 33-row 2026-01-19 and the off-hours alerts. Shifting v2 timestamps back 6 hours puts them on the legacy local-time basis, e.g. 12:12 UTC becomes 06:12 local, matching legacy start times.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
